bulleted_items.description: Listed as a class of anticoagulant medication (term only on page).
Bleeding-risk construct with example risk features listed: active cancer, male with uncontrolled hypertension at baseline, anaemia, history of bleeding, age ≥60 years, renal dysfunction.

preamble.summary: Guidelines summarize and evaluate available evidence to assist health professionals in proposing optimal management strategies for individual patients. Recommendations are intended to facilitate clinician decision-making, but final decisions rest with responsible health professionals in consultation with patients/caregivers.
notes: ESC (European Society of Cardiology) issues many guidelines; quality criteria and development recommendations are available on the ESC website.
ESC guidelines represent the official position of the ESC and are regularly updated.
ESC conducts registries to assess diagnostic/therapeutic processes, resource use and guideline adherence to improve understanding of medical practice.
